new_categories.label: cargo_distribution_condition_service_readiness
new_categories.memory: A bounded in-hold cargo-distribution/trim condition assurance state is distinct from cargo-handling equipment readiness and higher-level vessel stability calculations.

new_categories.label: cargo_distribution_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Distribution assurance can be bounded to a hold, zone or cargo parcel without retaining quantities, coordinates, exact profiles or loading plans.

new_categories.label: non_numeric_trim_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: Trim condition can be represented non-numerically without retaining angles, target profiles, tolerances or cargo-specific criteria.

new_categories.label: surface_profile_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence in a bounded cargo surface/profile condition is separable from total cargo quantity and from the equipment that produced the distribution.

new_categories.label: localized_loading_concern_state
new_categories.memory: A bounded localized-loading concern can be represented structurally without retaining exact loads, tank-top limits, pressure values or structural calculations.

new_categories.label: distribution_observation_availability
new_categories.memory: Observation availability for cargo distribution/trim is distinct from the underlying distribution state and can degrade independently.

new_categories.label: observation_representativeness_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence that observations represent the bounded cargo-distribution scope can be separated from observation availability without retaining survey patterns or measurement methods.

new_categories.label: cross_check_verification_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent or alternate verification confidence can be represented separately from primary distribution observations without retaining calculation or survey procedures.

new_categories.label: stability_strength_assurance_not_distribution_equivalence
new_categories.memory: Downstream stability or structural-strength assurance is not equivalent to, and does not prove, the underlying bounded cargo-distribution/trim condition.

new_categories.label: distribution_condition_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Distribution-condition assurance can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-restoration and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can attach separately to cargo scope, distribution condition, trim/profile confidence, localized-loading concern, observation availability or verification confidence.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Cargo-work restriction, stability/strength concern, terminal or receiver concern, rework or schedule effects do not prove a distribution, observation or bounded-scope root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_distribution_restoration
new_categories.memory: Distribution correction, observation recovery, cross-check verification, downstream assurance recovery and restriction release can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: cargo_handling_equipment_vs_distribution_condition
useful_refinements.memory: P087 cargo-handling/lifting service readiness does not establish the resulting in-hold cargo-distribution or trim condition.

useful_refinements.label: stability_hydrostatics_vs_local_distribution
useful_refinements.memory: P066 higher-level hydrostatics/stability orientation is downstream of and broader than bounded cargo-distribution/trim assurance.

useful_refinements.label: structural_boundary_vs_localized_loading_concern
useful_refinements.memory: P113 structural-boundary condition is distinct from the cargo-side localized-loading concern applied to that boundary.

useful_refinements.label: generic_observation_representativeness_vs_distribution_scope
useful_refinements.memory: Prior sampling/measurement representativeness patterns refine but do not duplicate bounded visual or observational confidence in cargo distribution/trim condition.

duplicates.label: generic_observation_validity_cross_check_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic observation availability, representativeness and cross-check mechanics repeat prior assurance families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic restriction/isolation, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage verified restoration are already campaign-wide.

negative_space: exact cargo-specific quantities, angles, profiles, loads, limits and current configuration

exact loading, trimming, leveling, redistribution, survey, correction, shutdown, isolation or emergency procedures

stop_reason: The bounded cargo-distribution/trim assurance questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact cargo quantities, profiles, loads, limits, calculations, loading/trimming procedures, providers or incidents that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive cargo-distribution/trim condition orientation and source-discovery output; not loading, trimming, stability, strength or structural-calculation guidance and not proof of any exact quantity, angle, load, limit, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
